name: @eradigm/api
description: Processing service: auth, submissions, capture, manual-entry drafts (optional LLM pre-fill), validation, storage, audit and admin (Cloudflare Worker + D1 + Queues).

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env dev --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --env dev --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state --file seed/seed.sql
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run db:migrate:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run db:migrate:production && wrangler deploy --env production
